name: American Sheet Metal Fabricators
old_description: American Sheet Metal Fabricators, Inc. “ASM” is a developed Union Local 73 fabrication shop in Chicagoland’s south side.  At American Sheet Metal Fabricators Inc, we are dedicated to providing our customers with high quality products and services at affordable prices. We value your business. We have made it our mission to provide reliable products and services in our customer-driven approach.
about:
American Sheet Metal Fabricators (ASM) operates as a Union Local 73 fabrication shop in South Holland, Illinois, on Chicago's south side. The business is led by the DeBartolo family: Dennis DeBartolo serves as president, Frank DeBartolo as vice president, Anthony DeBartolo as superintendent, and Christine DeBartolo as treasurer.

The shop produces a broad range of HVAC ductwork and fittings, including lockformed rectangular straight duct, snaplock and Pittsburgh-lock systems, welded rectangular and round duct in gauges from 16 ga to 1/4-inch black iron, stainless, and galvanized, double-wall rectangular and spiral duct with solid or perforated inner liners, spiral pipe from 4 to 40 inches in diameter, and acoustical liner installations. It also fabricates roof caps, custom drain pans, roof curbs, platform curbs, roof rails, register boxes, and painted duct components. Pre-assembled duct runs with collars and taps sealed and wrapped are offered as a labor-saving option, and same-day pickup is available for residential plenums, duct, and return-air elbows.

ASM serves mechanical and HVAC contractors in the Chicagoland area. A testimonial from the EMCOR Team, a national mechanical construction firm, references quick turnaround on orders, and the product line includes residential plenums and duct for same-day change-outs.

The company states its mission is to provide the highest quality products at the most reasonable prices, with fabrication to SMACNA standards and a focus on urgent delivery needs such as same-day pickup for change-out work.
